<1> oṃ namaḥ śrīgurave | [tataḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīkramathaṇḍilārcanaṃ] marjātātheṃvasaye || thaṇḍilihṅavane hna sakanatayā vachāyā snānayāya || tritatvena ācamanaṃ || khphreṁ hrāṁ ātmatatvāya svāhā || khphreṁ hrīṁ vidyātatvāya svāhā || khphreṁ hrūṁ śivatatvāya svāhā || thaṇḍilisagurunatkālaḥ || aiṁ <5> akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || guru brahmā gururviṣṇurgurudeva maheśvaraṃ | gurudeva jagat sarvaṃ tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || aiṁ <5> paramagurubhyo namaḥ || <5> parameṣṭhīgurubhyo pādukāṃ || aiṁ <5> paramācārya gurubhyo namaḥ || thaṇḍilayāhṅavanetaya hmasakanasa || aiṁ <5> akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ |
tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || gururbrahmā guruviṣṇurgurudeva maheśvaraṃ | guruddeva jagatsarvaṃ tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || aiṁ <5> paramagurubhyo namaḥ || aiṁ <5> parameṣṭhigurubhyo namaḥ || aiṁ <5> paramācāryagurubhyo namaḥ || valisaḥ || padmāsnāya pādukāṃ thavake || kūrmāsnāya pādukāṃ || pārśve akṣata vikaraṇaṃ || khphreṁ sakalaśatrupramarthani antaśaktidhāmne astrāya phaṭ pādukāṃ || vajra mudrāyā mukhaveṣṭanaṃ || khphreṁ hūṁ phaṭ vajrapañjale svāhā || daśadvārasparśanaṃ || khphre calamakule kulamacale hrīṁ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā || nyāsa || khphreṁ sakalaśatrupramathani anantaśaktidhāmne astrāya phaṭ ||
kalaśodhanaṃ || <4> || khphreṁ paramahaṃsini sarvajñātā śaktidhāmne aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || khphreṁ nirvāṇamārgade (*) ptiśaktidhāmne tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || khphreṁ viṣamopaplava praśamani anādibodhaśaktidhāmne madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || khphreṁ sakaladulitāriṣṭa kleśadalani svatantraśaktidhāmne anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ || khphreṁ sarvāpadāmbhodhitaraṇi aluptaśaktidhāmne kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || khphreṁ sakalaśatrupramathani anantaśaktidhāmne astrāya karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || karanyāsaḥ || khphreṁ namaḥ sarvasiddhi yoginībhyaḥ pūrvavaktranātha pādukāṃ || khphreṁ namaḥ sarvasiddhimātṛbhyo dakṣiṇavaktranātha pādukāṃ || khphreṁ namo nityoditānanda nanditāyai
uttaravaktranātha pādukāṃ || khphreṁ sakalakulacakranāyikāyai paścimavaktranātha pādukāṃ || khphreṁ bhagavatyai caṇḍakāpālinyai ūrddhavaktranātha pādukāṃ || vaktranyāsa || khphreṁ paramahaṃsini sarvajñātāśaktidhāmne hṛdayāya namaḥ || khphreṁ nirvāṇamārgade tṛptiśaktidhāmne śirase svāhā || khphreṁ viṣamopaplava prathamani anādibodhaśaktidhāmne śikhāyai vauṣaṭ || khphreṁ sakaladulitāriṣṭa kleśadalani svatantraśaktidhāmne kavacāya hūṁ || khphreṁ sarvāpadāmbhodhitaraṇi aluptaśaktidhāmne netratrayāya vauṣaṭ || khphreṁ sakalaśatrupramathani anantaśaktidhāmne astrāya phaṭ || ityaṃganyāsaḥ ||
jalapātrapūjā || khphreṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ jalapātrāsanāya pādukāṃ ||
khphreṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hskṣmlvryūṁ oṃ hrīṁ hūṁ hāṁ phreṁ kṣoṁ kroṁ namaḥ śrījalapātrabhaṭṭārikāya pādukāṃ || ṣaḍaṃga || khphreṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ khphreṁ śirase svāhā || khphreṁ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ || khphreṁ kavacāya hūṁ || khphreṁ netratrayāya vaṣaṭ || khphreṁ astrāya phaṭ || āvāhana sthāpaṇacaṇḍanākṣata (*) ṣpaṃ namaḥ || dhenumudrāṃ darśayet || gāyatri || khphreṁ siddhilakṣmyai vidmahe navatyadhika dhīmahi tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāt || abhiṣiñcanaṃ ||
arghapātrapūjā || khphreṁ hrīṁ śrī(-)arghapātrāsnāya pādukāṃ || khphreṁ hrīṁ śrī śkṣmlvryū(-)īṁ ānandabhairavāya vauṣaṭ || khphreṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ śvāṁ saḥ saḥ saḥ saḥ parādevi amṛtaṃ vama vama svāhā || dravyaśodhanaṃ || oṃ hrīṁ hūṁ hāṁ phreṁ kṣoṁ kroṁ namaḥ
arghapātrabhaṭṭārikā pukāṃ || ṣaḍaṃga || khphreṁ hṛdaya namaḥ || khphreṁ śirase svāhā || khphreṁ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ || khphreṁ kavacāya hūṃ || khphreṁ netratrayāya vaṣaṭ || khphreṁ astrāya phaṭ || āvāhanasthāpana candanākṣatapuṣpa namaḥ || yonimudrāṃ darśayet || kacchapamudrayā || bhūtaśuddhi || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hsphreṁ hsauṁ hsauṁ hsphreṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ aiṁ || ātmapūjā || khphreṁ ātmane caṇḍanaṃ pādukāṃ || khphreṁ akṣataṃ pādukāṃ || khphreṁ vīlabhasma pādukāṃ || khphreṁ sarvajanamohanī pādukāṃ || khphreṁ oṃ hrīṁ hūṁ hāṁ phreṁ kṣoṁ kroṁ namaḥ ātmane puṣpaṃ pādukāṃ || khphreṁ sakalaśatrūpramathanī anantaśaktidhāmne astrāya phaṭ || anena mantrena ātma śiraśi siṃcayet || <3> || hnasakanasa || āvāhanayāya || khphreṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ yā sā parā parā devī khaḍgastha khasvarūpiṇī ||
suralokagatā saumyā āyāntu iha maṇḍale || idaṃ āvāhiṣye āvāhayāmiḥ || triyāñjali || navātmā || aiṁ <5> hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandaśaktibhairavānanda vīrādhipataye śkṣmlvryīṁ śrīnavātmā gurumaṇḍalabhaṭṭārakāya pādukāṃ || karma || aiṁ <5> hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandaśaktibhairavānanda vīrādhipataye śkṣmlvryīṁ aṣṭaviṃśati karmabhabhaṭṭārikāya pādukāṃ || mūlasthāna || aiṁ <5> hskṣmlvryūṁ ānandaśaktibhairavānanda virādhipataye śkṣmlvryīṁ śrīpaścimamūlasthānabhaṭṭārikāyai pādukāṃ || tumbuleśvarī || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hskṣmlvryū śkṣmlvryīṁ śrījayatumbureśvarī pādukāṃ || śikhā || aiṁ <5> hsphreṁ hsphrīṁ hsphrūṁ śrīśikhāsvacchandabhairavāya pādukāṃ ||
mahākāla || aiṁ <5> hūṁ mahākāla mahābhairavāya sarvaśatrupramathanāya pādukāṃ || ugracaṇḍā || oṃ hrīṃ rājaprade hsphre ugracaṇḍe ripumardanī hūṁ phreṁ sadā rakṣa <2> tvāṃ māṃ juṃ saḥ mṛtyuhare pādukāṃ || ugracaṇḍī || oṃ hrīṁ rājaprade hsphreṁ ugracaṇḍī ripumardanī hūṁ phreṁ sadā rakṣa <2> tvāṃ māṃ juṃ saḥ mṛtyuhare pādukāṃ || siddhilakṣmī || aiṁ <5> oṃ hrīṁ hūṁ hāṁ phreṁ kṣoṁ kroṁ namaḥ || kālī || oṃ phreṁ siddhikarāli hrīṁ chrīṁ hūṁ strīṁ phreṁ namaḥ || tripurayā || aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ kilhrīṁ hskhrhrīṁ sklhrīṁ brahmacakre oḍiyānamahāpīṭhe caryānandanāthātmike śrīmahātripurasundarī devī parabrahmātmaśakti pādukāṃ || thvate mantraṇa pūjā || āvāhana
sthāpanacaṇḍamākṣatapuṣpaṃ namaḥ || yonimudrāṃ darśayet || taṃ hārapo pūjāyāya || oṃ gaṃgāyai namaḥ || oṃ yamunāyai namaḥ || oṃ narmadāyai namaḥ || oṃ kālaveryai namaḥ || oṃ kauśikyai namaḥ || oṃ gaṃḍakyai namaḥ || oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ || oṃ saṃpūrṇakalaśāya namaḥ || aiṁ <5> hskṣmlvryūṁ kulavṛkṣa mahāsena saṃmohana sakalatīrthamantrai devatā kalātatva tatvādhipataye brahmaviṣṇurudrātmane ātmavidyā śivatatvāya hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ saṃpūrṇakalasamūttaye pādukāṃ || āvāhanādi || dhenumudrāṃ darśayet || āmnāya vākyakāyā vahmasakanasa || snānaṃ || (***?) || ūkāraṃ vāyubījaṃ tadupari varuṇaṃ vajrapāṇintadūrdhvaṃ kalaṃ varṇāntayuktaṃ tadupari paramaṃ
vahnibījaṃ sahaṃsaṃ | induṃ binduṃ layāntaṃ sitakamalavaraṃ kṣīradhārāśravantaṃ dṛṣṭvākūtaṃ tu nityaṃ dahati kulamalaṃ meru tulyaṃ hi pāpaṃ || duduyā || payasāṃ paya bhūmaiva pṛthivyāṃ yūtameva ca | kāmadhenu śravaṃ nityaṃ snāpayāmi śivājñayā || dharīyā || dadhicomāpatiṃ devaṃ devānāṃ priya vallabhaṃ | snāpayāmi sadā nityaṃ suprītā devatāḥ sadā || gherayā || ghṛtapūtapinākinaṃ liṅgapūta pinākinaṃ | agni sarpi svarūpeṇa trilokaṃ janakaṃ śivaṃ || kastiyā || gomukhī śaktinodbhūtaṃ devānāṃ priya vallabhaṃ | vācchākalpatarusthena yena snānena labhyate || sākharayā || khaṇḍametat mahāsvādu manasā śītalaṃ sadā | khaṇḍedu snāpitā devī akhaṇḍita varapradā || tathā pañcādi payasaṃ pañcabrahmādi vāsanaṃ | paṃcadravya samāyuktaṃ pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayāmyahaṃ || hna sakanasalaṃkhadhārahāyake || aiṁ <5> śrīsaṃvartāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭinyāya catuṣkaṃ tva kulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ | catvāroḥ pañcakonyaḥ punarapi caturastatvato maṇḍaledaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || thaṇḍilasalaṃkhanahāya || ūkāraṃ vāyubījaṃ tadupari varuṇaṃ vajrapāṇintadūrddhvaṃ kālaṃ varṇāntayuktaṃ tadupari paramaṃ vahnibījaṃ sahaṃ sa | induṃ binduṃ layāntaṃ sitakamalavaraṃ kṣīradhārā śravantaṃ dṛkṣvākūṭaṃ tu nityaṃ dahati kulamalaṃ meru tulyaṃ hi pāpaṃ ||

anantādi aṣṭakulanāgebhyo namaḥ || rudracaṇḍādi || śrīrudracaṇḍā devī pādukāṃ || śrīpracaṇḍā devī pādukāṃ || śrīcaṇḍogrā devī pādukāṃ || śrīcaṇḍanāyikā devī pādukāṃ || śrīcaṇḍā devī pādukāṃ || śrīcaṇḍavati devī pādukāṃ || śrīcaṇḍarūpā devī pādukāṃ || śrī aticaṇḍikā devī pādukāṃ || aiṁ <5> hskṣmlvryūṁ sapūrṇakalaśamūrtaye pādukāṃ || bali || triyāñjali <3> || aiṁ <5> hskṣmlvryūṁ kulavṛkṣa mahāsena saṃmohanasakalatīrthamantradevatā kalātatvatatvādhipataye brahmaviṣṇurudrātmavidyā śivatatvāya hskṣmlvryūṁ śkṣmlvryīṁ śrīsaṃpūrṇakalaśamūrtaye namaḥ || ṣaḍaṃgaḥ || oṃ juṁ saḥ mṛtyuṃjayāya hṛdayāya namaḥ || oṃ juṁ saḥ mṛtyuṃjayāya śirase svāhā ||
oṃ juṁ saḥ mṛtyuṃjayāya śikhāya vauṣaṭ || oṃ juṁ saḥ mṛtyuṃjayāya kavacāya hūṁ || oṃ juṁ saḥ mṛtyuṃjayāya netratrayāya vaṣaṭ || oṃ juṁ saḥ mṛtyuṃjāyāya astrāya phaṭ || baliḥ || hnasakanaśriyai namaḥ || siṃdhramuṅa || lakṣmyai namaḥ || āvāhanādi || dhenumudrāṃ darśayet || japa || oṃ juṁ saḥ svāhā || <10> || stotra || brahmāṇḍamukhyaiḥ sulalokapālairabhyarccito yaḥ praṇatastutaśca | tvameva yaṃ bhairavamādidevaṃ mṛtyuñjayākhyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || atra gandhapuṣpadhūpa arcane pūjāvidhānaṃ tatsarvaṃ paripūrṇamastu || iti kalasapūjā ||

bandhamokṣakarī devī ṣoḍaśānte vyavasthite | bhramaṇī śakti śūlena mahāvyūha samanvite || bhramaṇī bhrāmaṇī gaurī māyāyantrapavāhinī | svacchandabhairavī devī krodha unmattabhairavī || pañcāśadvarṇarūpasthā tvayā rudrā prakīrtitā | amṛtākhye ruruścaṇḍe namaste jñānabhairavī || daṃṣṭrotkaṭe vidyujjihve tārakākṣi bhayānane | namāmi devadeveśi aghore ghoravikrame || jvālāmukhī vegavatī umādevī sarasvatī | yoginī ca śriyādevī gaurīlakṣmīsarasvatī || haṃsasvarorddhage devī gomukhī śaktimālinī | kroṣṭakī subhagā devī durgā kātyāyanī tathā || nityaṃ klinnā samākhyātā raktācaikākṣarā parā | brāhmī māheśvarī caiva komāri vaiṣṇavī tathā || vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍā tvaṃ bhayānanā | yogeśī tvaṃ hitā deveśi kulāṣṭaka vibhūṣite || aṣṭāṣṭaka dharī devī lakṣmī tvaṃ vahurūpinī | aindrī caiva tu āgneyī yāmyā nai(-)ṛtya vāruṇī || vāyuvyāṃ caiva kauverī īśānyā ca mudāhṛtāḥ | prayāgā varuṇākolā aṭṭahāsā jayantikā || caritraikā ekaṃ caiva devīkoṭaṃ tu cāṣṭakamaṃ | tathā kālī umādevī devadutī namostute || bhadrakālī mahādevī carmamuṇḍā bhayāvahe | mahocchukṣme mahāśānte namaste śaktirūpiṇī | bhūrbhuva sveti svāhānte dayānāthaṃ kuruṣva me || jñānārthito mahāmāye etadicchāmi vedituṃ ||
yastvidaṃ paṭhyate stotraṃ trisaṃdhyāṃ caiva mānavaḥ || prāpnoti cintitānkāmāṃ strīṇāṃ bhavati vallabhaḥ || iti śivaśakti sarasatve mahāmāyā stotraṃ samāptaṃ ||
piṅgākṣi raktakeśaṃ kiṇi kiṇi savaraṃ kiṅkimālajālaṃ daṣṭrāsyaṃ krūrabhāvaṃ sakalabhayaharaṃ pātrahastaṃ ca nādaṃ | suvyaktaṃ siṃhanādaṃ ra ra ra ra ra varaṃ varvalaṃ vyomatatvaṃ bhūtapretādināthaṃ grahagaṇasahitaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ namāmi || raktāmbaraṃ jvalitapiṅgajaṭākalāpaṃ jvarāvalī dadhati daṇḍarapracaṇḍaṃ | sūryodayā kanakakāñcana śṛṅgagauraṃ gaurīsutaṃ vaṭukanāthamahaṃ namāmi || hantāṣākhoduduḥkhaṃ samitabhavabhayaṃ sarvavighnātakāyaṃ gāṁ gīṁ gūṁ gaiḥ gaḥ
ṣaḍaṅge gagaṇagaṇigate siddhi sarvārthadāya | oṃ glūṁ mudrā gajākhye gasapavanagate ākhuyāneka draṃṣṭre oṃ hrīṁ hūṁ hāṁ gāṁ gaṇeśe dviradupati mukho vighnanāthe namaste ||
brahmāṇīya || brahmāṇī haṃsayānāṃ drūtakanakanibhāṃmadvivaktrāṃ trinetrāṃ hastāgre brahmakūrcaṃ kalaśamapi lasaddaṇḍamabjākṣamālāṃ | vibhrāṇāṃ cāruveṣā mathaharihayadikpatramūle jayattāṃ gaṃdhādyaiḥ karvurāṃgīmvahati vara jaṭājūṭabhāraṃ namāmi || <1> ||
maheśvarīyā || māheśīntāṃ kapāloḍḍamamuḍamarukābhīti śūloruṭaṃ kāṃ vibhrāṇāṃ vā kudaṇḍairniviḍa himanibhāmagni dikputramūle | naitrairudbhāsamānāṃ tribhiraruṇajaṭākoṭi varddhendu khaṇḍā gaṃdhādyaiḥ pūjayedyā vṛṣabhamuḍugatā nityamāruhyayāti || <2> ||
komāriyā || kaumārī yauvanāḍhyāṃ suruciravavadanāṃ kuṅkumābhāṃ suśobhāṃ śaktiṃ pāśāṃkuśe yā vahati nijakarai dakṣiṇe cābhayañca | hālālolā viśālāṃ lasanayanayugāmarcayedgandhapuṣpaiḥ sarvālaṃkālayuktāṃ śikhiniyama diśā patra mūlenivarṇāṃ || <3> ||
vaiṣṇavīyā || rakṣo dikpatramūle sajalajaladharaśyāmalāṅgīṃ sukeśī ghaṇṭhāṃ kambukapālaṃ rathacaraṇamatho vibhratī vāhudaṇḍaiḥ | āsīnāṃ vaiṇateya maṇimayamukuṭodbhāsitāṃ vaiṣṇavīntāṃ gaṃdhādyairarcayedyā madhumadamuditā nityamālola tṛptiṃ || <4> ||
vārāhiyā || vārāhī kheṭakāsyudbhayamuśalahalāṃ vibhratī potrivaktrāṃ pāścātye patramūle maṇimaya vilasatkuṇḍalodghṛṣṭa gaṃḍāṃ | pāśaśvadviśva pūjyā giriśikharakharābhīmakole niṣarṇṇāṃ gaṃdhādyairarcayet tāṃ suruciradaśanāṃ dhūmadhūmrāṅga kāntiṃ || <5> ||
indrāṇīyā || indrāṇīṃ candrabimbapratimayamukuṭāṃ vāyu dikpatra mūlo cāpaṃ kaṃbūṃ triśūlaṃ śaramapi dadhatiṃ hastapadmaiścaturbhi(-) svai mātaṅge niṣarṇṇā suravaravinutāmarcayennitya mattāṃ || <6> ||
cāmuṇḍāyā || cāmuṇḍā caṇḍahāsodbhaṭa vikaṭaradā bhīnnavaktrāṃ trinetrāṃ khaḍgaṃ śūlaṃ kapālaṃ nijakarakamarairvibhratī kheṭakaṃ ca | nirmāṃsā rakta netrā tribhuvana bhayadāṃ saumya dikpatramūle kālaṃ kaṃkālabhūṣāṃ pitṛvananilayāmarcayedūrddhvakeśīṃ || <7> ||
mahālakṣmayā || paścādāścaryarūpāṃ surucira vadanāṃ śuddhajāṃbunadābhāṃ hastābjai rakṣasūtrābhayakamalalasanmātuluṃgaṃ phalāni | vibhrāṇāmarcayantāṃ tribhuvanajalaḍādyarcitāṃ lakṣaḍhyāṃ lakṣmīmutuṃga pīnastanabharaṇamitāmīśa dikpatramūle || <8> ||
thvate brahmāṇyādi || aśitāṅgādi || namo sitāṅge ruru caṇḍasaṃjñakaḥ krodhīśamunmattakapalabhairavaḥ | palāśamadhye tvatha bhīṣaṇākhyaḥ saṃhārasaṃjñaṃ praṇamāmi bhairavān || hetukādi || yo hetuko yantri purāntakaśca yo vahni vetālahutāśa jihvaḥ | kālaṃ kapālaṃ ca tathaika pādau bhīmākṛtiryaḥ khalu bhīmarūpaṃ ||
ugraca(?)ṇḍāyā || mahiṣaghne mahāmāye caṇḍamuṇḍavināśine | raktabīja hare devī ugracaṇḍīṃ namāmyahaṃ ||
vagalāyā || vādīmūkatiraṃkatiḥ kṣitipatirvaiśvānaraḥ śītati krodhī sāmyati durjana sujanati kṣiprā dhvagaḥ khaṃjati | garvī kharvati sarvavirjaḍayati tvadyaṃtraṇā yantritaṃ śrīnitye vagalāmukhi pratidinaṃ kalyāṇi tubhyaṃ namaḥ ||
triśaktiyā || raktāśuklāti kṛṣṇā tripathagatiyutā striṇī devyā trimātrā tvāṃ stutvā ye palabdhā vivadhapadagatā triṇi vargā prasirddhā | tāruṇyā bālavṛddhā bhavati bhavatarā triṇī kālaprabodhā vetāmātāsugarbhāya yatu jayapradā nityapūjā śivāṅgā ||
hanubhairavayā || namāmi parameśānaṃ rudraṃ bhairavarūpiṇaṃ | trailokya lakṣaṇaṃ devaṃ ḍāmarādhipatiṃ prabhuṃ ||
nāṭeśvarayā || pāṇibhyāṃ parita prapīḍyanala sanniścotpaniścotpaca brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ pacelimalasat proccairphalobhaṃ mukhaḥ(?) | pāyaṃ pāyamapāyatantrijaṭomunmattavantairasai(-) rnṛtyasthāṇḍavaḍambareṇa vidhinā pāyāṃ mahābhairavaḥ ||
pañcamī vārāhīyā || nama'stute mahāmāye vārāhī nāmadhāriṇī | kolāsyāṃ ca mahāraudri vajratuṇḍadharāyani ||
siddheśvarayā || ekāsyāṃ trilocanā sā khandendu kṛta śekharā | caturhastā maheśāni dvayahastakṛtāñjarī || pretāsanopariṣṭhantu raktavarṇā mahojvalā | koṭipūrṇe nibhā devī jalatmāna sutejasaḥ ||
chinnamastāyā || nābhau śubhrārabindaṃ tadupari vimalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ caṇḍaraśneḥ saṃsārasyaikasāra tribhuvana jananīṃ dharma karmodayāya |
tasmin madhye trimārge tritayatanudharāṃ chinnamastā prasastāṃ tāṃ vande jñānarūpāṃ maraṇabhayaharāṃ yoginīyoga mudrāṃ || ūkāro nṛtyapādau hasakṣamalavujovodaraścāgni liṅga vāyuvyāṃghrāñjināka śaśisakalaśiro bindunādordhayukta | nirjidgaṅgāmbudhārā ṛju paramakalā bhairavo mantramūrtiḥ pāyāddevo navātmā sakalaguruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || brahmāṇī kamalendu saumya vadanī māheśvarī līlayā kaumārī ripudarpaṇāśanakarī cakrāyudhā vaiṣṇavī | vārāhī ghanaghora ghargharamukhī aindrī ca vajrāyudhā cāmuṇḍā gaṇanāthabhairavagaṇāḥ rakṣantu me mātṛkā || madhyatriśrāsanasthāmadamuditamukhī vajrapadmo sudīptā brahmāṇyādyaṣṭa patre svaradigapraṇave śrīprayāgādi kṣetre | yuktāstā viṃśakoṇe vasaṣasahakṣe vajraśṛṃge sphuranti sāṣṭāviṃśā tribhedā kramapada sahitā pātu dvātriṃśavarṇā || khaḍgambāmantrasiddhi puravaravyasanaṃ khegatirlocanaṃ vā śatrustaṃbhaṃ ripūṇāṃ alivalitajayaṃ staṃbhanaṃ sarvavidyā | dīghāyuṣyaṃ kavitvaṃ nidhirasaguṭikāṃ pādukāṃ kāmasiddhiṃḥ sarvācintādadante alivali sahitā bhairavenānyayuktā || syāmāraktā trinetrā stanabharaṇamitā mattamātaṅgagāmī bimboṣṭhī cārunetrā pṛthutarajaghanāmekhalā ratnaśobhe | devāṅge vastrasobhe valavalakusume varvare keśabhāre syāme śrīkubjikākhyā vitaratutarasājñānadivyoghamoghaṃ ||
bandhukadyuti saṃnibhāṃ trinayanīṃ siṃhāsanīṃ sundarīṃ sarveṣāmiha sarvaśatru haraṇīṃ śuklāmbarā bhūṣitāṃ | yasyāṣṭādaśa pāṇipadma vimalāṃ vāṃcchāphalārtha pradāṃ tāṃ vande mahiṣāsura pramathanīṃ tumbeśvarīmambikāṃ || kvā kvāśa kvasamīraṇa kvadahanaḥ kvāpaḥ kva viśvaṃbharā kva brahmā kvajanārdanaḥ kva bhujagaḥ kvendraḥ kva devāsuraḥ | kalpāntālabhaṭainataḥ pramuditaḥ śrīsiddhiyogeśvaraḥ krīḍānāṭakanāyako vijayate devo mahābhairavaḥ || mahākālaṃ mahārudraṃ mahākṛṣṇāñjana prabhuḥ | sthūlarūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ kartikāpāladhāriṇaṃ || khaḍgapheṭakadharaṃ devaṃ trinetra jvalana prabhaṃ | namaste'stu mahākāla śatrusaṃhāranāśanaṃ ||
mārkaṇḍeyo vipadupahatānugrahā yāvatāraṃ cakre yasya pracūrṇakaro brahmaṇī brahmaṇyaḥ || daito cheda pramudita śira stotragarbha prabhā vāsoyaṃ devyā bhavatu bhavasadā śrīyasya caṇḍikāyāḥ || yā devī madhukaiṭabhapramathanī yā caṇḍamuṇḍāśanī yā mātryā mahiṣāsurakṣayakarī yā raktabījāśrīyā | yā sā śumbhaniśumbhadaityadalani yā devadevā śriyā sā devī mama rakṣa dakṣiṇabhujaiścaṇḍi jayo rakṣatu || utphullāṃbuja karṇikoparigatā śrīsiddhilakṣmī parā kaṣpūra sphaṭikendu kundadhavalā niḥśeṣapāśopahā | saṃsārārṇavaduḥkha paṅkajahari niṣkaṃpano sarvadā śrīmatpañca mukhāmbujā daśabhujā preta sthitā pātu vaḥ ||
āsāpūriṇi pāpahāriṇi jagadduḥkhaugha viṃdhvaṃsinī kleśottāriṇi vairimāriṇi jagansaṃsāre mohāntakīḥ | śejaskāraṇi kāraṇe suravaraḥ prāṇārti saṃcāriṇe tvāṃ sadyo suradā abhimata phaladā śrīsiddhilakṣmī namaḥ || yā sāntakāgni kuharo sthiti bhāsvarūpā somārka vahniti patho dalamadhya sasthā | circetacittaviṣayākṣa valīna bhāvā sṛṣṭi sthiti pralakāraṇa tatvarūpā || jñānātmikā sakalabhāvavibhāgabhinnā ānandanandita sadāparamārthalīnāḥ | nāḍī kalākalitavigrahamantrarūpā saptādaśākṣara gatakhalūcchidravarṇā || vidyāśatākṣara gatā kūlakarmacaṇḍā trailokyaraṃpatavarākulasaṃgasiddhā | ekā hyenekagati cakravara prapūjyā satsaṃgasiddhivara bhairavapūjitāyā ||
kālīkalākalitakālakalormi vāhā śrīcakracakranilayānavabhedabhinnā | pūrṇā śaśāṅka kalitā kulabhānurūpā vijñānasiddhivara vahni kulaprasiddhā || ālabdha khecara padā paramapracaṇḍā cakrameṇagadita mantramahārthavelā | satsaṅgayoganiratā kulasiddhidātri svābhāvibhāviki parāṃ praṇamāmi kālīṃ || aindrasyaiva śarāsanasya dadhatī madhye lalāṭe prabhā sauṁ klīṁ kāntimanusta gaurī vaśīrasyāstanvatī sarvataḥ | eṣāsau tripurā hṛtidyutirivoṣṇāṃśo sadāha sthitā chindyādvasahasāvali tripuraghaṃ jyotirmayī vāṅmayī || māyā kuṇḍalanī kriyā madhumatī kālīkalāmālinī
mātaṅgī vijayā jayā bhagavatī devī śivā sāmbhavī | śaktiḥ śaṃkaravallabhā trinayanī vāgvādinī bhairavī hrīṁ kālī tripurā parāparamakhī mātā kukārītyasi || namaste devadeveśi siddhilakṣmī mahaujasā | pratyaṃgirā mahādevī rājyalakṣmī namostute || tvamasi paramakālī siddhilakṣmīstvameva tvamasi paracaṇḍī ugracaṇḍī tvameva | tvamasi paramarājaṃ rājarājeśvarī tvaṃ sakalanihata satpuṃ sarvasiddhiṃ dadātu || nānyaṃ vadāmi na ca śṛṇomi na cintayāmi nānyaṃ smarāmi nabhajāmi na cāśrayāmi | muktā tvadīya caraṇāvujamādareṇa māṃ pāhi bhūti kṛpayā mama dehi siddhiṃ || yathāvāṇa prahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ bhavati vāraṇaṃ | vadvadeva vidhātrāṇāṃ śāntirbhavatu vāraṇaṃ ||
